about: Between Lumbridge Castle and Draynor Village, round the H.A.M. Hideout's trapdoor (Misthalin piece 7 step 1): the level 2 goblins (goblin_unarmed_melee_1 to 7, ids 3029 to 3035), the level 2 giant spiders (giantspider1, 3017) and the level 1 spiders (spider, 3019) that mejrs's live NPC list sees at x 3141 to 3170, z 3222 to 3261, and that no other spawn file had (checked tile by tile, 2026-11-09). Each tile and type is mejrs's; every wander range is guessed (5), as elsewhere. Their combat and drops are npc-combat.json's and npc-drops.json's, as for the same types east of the river.
